nodes.strategy_note: Rotate the hardest tasks (pipe insulation, transformer work, cable pulling, trenching) across the whole crew in short single-slot stints. Interleave them with lighter or indoor tasks. Front-load heavy work into the early morning, especially for new hires and temps. Keep midday and early afternoon for light tasks, so no one stays on one hard task for long.
